title: After a pushed article is deleted on live and synced, a new copy article is pushed as a create
steps: Run the live-push-flow case for #223/#307: push a new article, delete it on live, Sync from live, make another article on the copy, preview Sync to live.
Run the live-push-changeset case for #307: an article a sync kept though live deleted it, with and without its kept place.
expect: The id map no longer names the deleted article, the new article takes a higher number, and the preview lists it as article:new:<id> create with no live-record refusal.
With the kept place: article:new:7 is held as changed-on-both, no live-record refusal. Without: a plain create.

tests: an article a push created and the customer then deleted on the live site goes from the copy too
Joomla: an article a sync kept though the live site deleted it
